text:
Leah (product): Need a tiny, exec-friendly card for tomorrow: per-route 24h net token cost (USD) + cache savings %, plus a tiny SLO-hit indicator (green/yellow/red). One-line primary answer.
Diego (telemetry): Clarify: do we want raw token totals or normalized net-cost (token * model_price - cache_credit)? sampling affects accuracy; many low-traffic routes only sampled 1/200.
Leah (product): Net-cost preferred. Show tokens too optionally. If sampling low, show a confidence badge.
Nora (frontend): UI constraints: card must fit on the compact row. Proposal: left: route name, center: net cost (USD) with small sparkline, right: cache % and SLO dot. Tap opens modal with breakdown (tokens, cache_hits, model split). Also add tooltip explaining attribution.
Ravi (infra): Attribution wrinkle: shared prefetch pools/sidecars create ambiguity. Two options: (A) attribute prefetch savings proportionally by route historical traffic, (B) attribute to pool and surface "shared savings" line in modal. Option (A) is easier for per-route ranking; (B) is more honest.
Diego (telemetry): I'll compute a derived metric net_cost_route_24h but it requires joining invocations -> model_sku -> cache_event streams. For accuracy we can: 1) use per-router rolling gauge (emit tokens and cache_hits per route every 60s) OR 2) run a sampled reingest + join job for the 24h window. Gauges give near realtime and deterministic attribution; sampled reingest cheaper but lower confidence.
Leah (product): Realtime-ish would be nice but demo can use a 24h batch reingest if that's faster to ship. Confidence badge still required.
Nora (frontend): API contract request for prototype: /api/internal/costs/route_summary?period=24h returns a compact record. Example payload we expect in prototype:
```json
{
  "route": "search-suggest",
  "period": "24h",
  "tokens": 412345,
  "cache_savings_pct": 0.27,
  "net_usd": 12.34,
  "slo_hit_pct": 99.3,
  "confidence": 0.88,
  "provenance": "estimation",
  "sample_count": 420
}
```
Diego (telemetry): I'll add sample_count and provenance ("gauge"|"sampled_backfill"|"hybrid"). Also we'll tag routes with "low_confidence" if sample_count < 100.
Ravi (infra): Implementation plan: i'll add a lightweight router gauge export (per-route labels) emitting tokens and cache_hits; a small aggregator job pulls the minute metrics, reduces to 24h window and writes to a fast key-value store the API will read. Fallback: if gauge absent, serve sampled_backfill result. Estimated infra/dev effort: ~1.5 engineer-days (Ravi + Diego) to stage.
Nora (frontend): I'll build a mock using the KPI small widget and wire to a feature flag. Modal will show per-model rows (model_name, tokens, cache_savings, model_cost_usd).
Leah (product): Acceptance criteria for demo: card displayed in the compact dashboard row; shows route, net_usd, small sparkline, cache_savings_pct, SLO dot; clicking opens modal with per-model breakdown and provenance note. Low confidence routes show a yellow badge and hover text.
Diego (telemetry): One more: we should expose an explicit "attribution_mode" used to compute the number (proportional|pool_assigned). That will help follow-ups.
Ravi (infra): Agreed. We'll default to proportional for the demo and note it in tooltip. For long-term we can add pool-level savings.
Leah (product): Timeline: 2-day spike. Day 1: telemetry + infra produce API and staging dataset; frontend wires mock and modal. Day 2: polish, flag rollout, gather sample screenshots for exec.
deploy-bot: staging build for compact-cost-card passed  https://staging.ci.redwood/dashboard/preview/6471230000 :white_check_mark:
Nora (frontend): I'll also add an accessibility text alternative and ensure color-blind pallette for SLO dot.
Diego (telemetry): I'll push a small synthetic payload set to the staging API so front-end has realistic numbers and confidence values.
Ravi (infra): Heads-up: watch the aggregator memory if we reingest many low-traffic routes. We'll cap the demo to top-50 routes for now.
Leah (product): Perfect. Tagging team: @diego @nora @ravi. We'll reconvene in 90 minutes to sync. Thanks! :sparkles:
